alerts.triggerSummary: A Deployment cannot pull its configured container image.

rule.expression: max by (namespace, deployment) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason=~"ErrImagePull|ImagePullBackOff"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) > 0

panels.title: 镜像拉取失败 Pod
panels.purpose: 因镜像拉取失败而等待的 Pod 数，衡量影响范围，不说明失败原因。
panels.queryTemplate: sum(max by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace="{{namespace}}",reason=~"ErrImagePull|ImagePullBackOff"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"))) or (max(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}) * 0)

panels.title: Deployment 可用副本
panels.purpose: 当前可用副本数，与期望副本对照看容量缺口。
panels.queryTemplate: max(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="{{namespace}}",deployment="{{name}}"})

alerts.triggerSummary: A Deployment container repeatedly exits and is waiting in CrashLoopBackOff.

rule.expression: max by (namespace, deployment) (max by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="CrashLoopBackOff"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total > 0)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) > 0

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.purpose: 容器累计重启次数（counter），看窗口内的增长而非绝对值。
panels.queryTemplate: sum(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="{{namespace}}"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) or (max(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}) * 0)

panels.title: CrashLoopBackOff containers
panels.purpose: 处于 CrashLoopBackOff 的容器数，衡量反复退出的规模，不说明退出原因。
panels.queryTemplate: sum((kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace="{{namespace}}",reason="CrashLoopBackOff"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) or (max(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}) * 0)

alerts.triggerSummary: A Deployment has fewer available replicas than desired.

panels.title: Deployment 副本缺口
panels.purpose: 期望副本减可用副本（不小于 0），大于 0 表示缺口仍在。
panels.queryTemplate: clamp_min(max(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="{{namespace}}",deployment="{{name}}"}) - max(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="{{namespace}}",deployment="{{name}}"}), 0)

alerts.triggerSummary: A monitored selector-based Service has candidate Pods but no ready EndpointSlice endpoints.

rule.expression: (((max by (namespace, service) (kube_service_labels{label_k8s_incident_agent_io_monitor_selector="true"}) * on (namespace, service) max by (namespace, service) (kube_service_spec_type{type=~"ClusterIP|NodePort|LoadBalancer"} == 1)) * on (namespace, service) max by (namespace, service) (kube_service_info{cluster_ip!="None"} == 1)) and on (namespace, service) max by (namespace, service) (label_replace(kube_pod_labels{label_k8s_incident_agent_io_service!=""}, "service", "$1", "label_k8s_incident_agent_io_service", "(.+)"))) unless on (namespace, service) max by (namespace, service) ((kube_endpointslice_endpoints{ready="true"} > 0) * on (namespace, endpointslice) group_left(service) label_replace(kube_endpointslice_labels{label_kubernetes_io_service_name!=""}, "service", "$1", "label_kubernetes_io_service_name", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Service 就绪 Endpoint
panels.purpose: 就绪 Endpoint 数；0 表示没有后端可接流量，不证明网络连通性。
panels.queryTemplate: sum((kube_endpointslice_endpoints{namespace="{{namespace}}",ready="true"} > 0) * on (namespace, endpointslice) group_left(service) label_replace(kube_endpointslice_labels{namespace="{{namespace}}",label_kubernetes_io_service_name="{{name}}"}, "service", "$1", "label_kubernetes_io_service_name", "(.+)")) or (max(kube_service_info{namespace="{{namespace}}",service="{{name}}"}) * 0)

alerts.triggerSummary: A monitored Deployment container remains running but is not ready.

rule.expression: max by (namespace, deployment) (max by (namespace, pod) (((kube_pod_container_status_ready == bool 0) * on (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_running == 1)) * on (namespace, pod, container) label_replace(kube_pod_labels{label_k8s_incident_agent_io_readiness_container!="",label_k8s_incident_agent_io_readiness_slo="2m"} == 1, "container", "$1", "label_k8s_incident_agent_io_readiness_container", "(.+)")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) > 0

panels.title: Readiness 未就绪容器
panels.purpose: 受控容器中 Running 但未 Ready 的数量，不说明应用原因。
panels.queryTemplate: sum((((kube_pod_container_status_ready{namespace="{{namespace}}"} == bool 0) * on (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_running{namespace="{{namespace}}"} == 1)) * on (namespace, pod, container) label_replace(kube_pod_labels{namespace="{{namespace}}",label_k8s_incident_agent_io_readiness_container!="",label_k8s_incident_agent_io_readiness_slo="2m"} == 1, "container", "$1", "label_k8s_incident_agent_io_readiness_container", "(.+)")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) or (max(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}) * 0)

alerts.triggerSummary: A Deployment container selected for liveness monitoring restarted.

rule.expression: max by (namespace, deployment) (max by (namespace, pod) ((increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[5m]) > 0) * on (namespace, pod, container) label_replace(kube_pod_labels{label_k8s_incident_agent_io_liveness_container!=""} == 1, "container", "$1", "label_k8s_incident_agent_io_liveness_container", "(.+)")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) > 0

panels.title: Liveness 重启估算
panels.purpose: 受控 liveness 容器每个采样区间（至少 5 分钟）的重启增量估算；重启不证明 liveness 失败。
panels.queryTemplate: sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="{{namespace}}"}[{{range:5m}}]) * on (namespace, pod, container) label_replace(kube_pod_labels{namespace="{{namespace}}",label_k8s_incident_agent_io_liveness_container!=""} == 1, "container", "$1", "label_k8s_incident_agent_io_liveness_container", "(.+)") * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) or (max(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}) * 0)

alerts.triggerSummary: A Deployment container was terminated with OOMKilled in the last 10 minutes.

rule.expression: max by (namespace, deployment) (max by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"} == 1) and on (namespace, pod, uid, container) ((time() - kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_timestamp) < 600)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) > 0 unless on (namespace, deployment) max_over_time(ALERTS{alertname="K8sIncidentCrashLoopBackOff"}[10m])

panels.title: OOM 终止容器数
panels.purpose: 每个采样区间（至少 10 分钟）内最近一次终止原因为 OOMKilled 的容器数；按同一 Pod UID 与容器判定，不说明内存为何耗尽。
panels.queryTemplate: sum(((kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="{{namespace}}",reason="OOMKilled"} == 1) and on (namespace, pod, uid, container) ((time() - kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_timestamp{namespace="{{namespace}}"}) < {{rangeSeconds:10m}})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) or (max(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}) * 0)

alerts.triggerSummary: A Deployment container restarted after a non-zero or abnormal termination.

rule.expression: max by (namespace, deployment) (max by (namespace, pod) ((increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[10m]) > 0) and on (namespace, pod, uid, container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason!~"Completed|OOMKilled"} == 1)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) > 0 unless on (namespace, deployment) max_over_time(ALERTS{alertname=~"K8sIncidentCrashLoopBackOff|K8sIncidentLivenessProbeRestart|K8sIncidentContainerOOMKilled|K8sIncidentContainerProbeFailing"}[10m])

panels.title: 异常退出容器数
panels.purpose: 每个采样区间（至少 10 分钟）内发生重启、且最近一次终止原因不是 Completed 或 OOMKilled 的容器数；正常退出不计入。
panels.queryTemplate: sum(((increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="{{namespace}}"}[{{range:10m}}]) > bool 0) and on (namespace, pod, uid, container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="{{namespace}}",reason!~"Completed|OOMKilled"} == 1)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) or (max(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}) * 0)

alerts.triggerSummary: A Deployment container's memory working set stays above 90% of its memory limit.

rule.expression: max by (namespace, deployment) (max by (namespace, pod) ((max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet-resource"}) / on (namespace, pod, container) (max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"}) > 0)) > 0.9) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) > 0

panels.title: 内存逼近 limit 的容器数
panels.purpose: 内存工作集超过有效 memory limit 90% 的容器数；未配置 limit 的容器不参与，没有 kubelet 数据时无样本。表示有压力，不代表已 OOM。
panels.queryTemplate: sum(((max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="{{namespace}}",job="kubelet-resource"}) / on (namespace, pod, container) (max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="{{namespace}}",resource="memory"}) > 0)) > bool 0.9) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"))

alerts.triggerSummary: A Deployment container spends more than 25% of its CFS periods throttled.

rule.expression: max by (namespace, deployment) (max by (namespace, pod) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{job="kubelet-cadvisor"}[5m])) / on (namespace, pod, container) (sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{job="kubelet-cadvisor"}[5m])) > 0)) > 0.25) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) > 0

panels.title: CPU 持续限流的容器数
panels.purpose: 每个采样区间（至少 5 分钟）内被 CFS 限流周期超过 25% 的容器数；没有 CPU limit 或没有调度周期的容器不参与。
panels.queryTemplate: sum(((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="{{namespace}}",job="kubelet-cadvisor"}[{{range:5m}}])) / on (namespace, pod, container) (sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="{{namespace}}",job="kubelet-cadvisor"}[{{range:5m}}])) > 0)) > bool 0.25) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"))

alerts.triggerSummary: A started Deployment container keeps failing its probes outside the controlled readiness and liveness rules.

rule.expression: max by (namespace, deployment) (max by (namespace, pod) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(prober_probe_total{job="kubelet-probes",result="failed"}[5m])) >= 3) and on (namespace, pod, container) ((time() - max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_state_started)) > 300) unless on (namespace, pod, container) label_replace(kube_pod_labels{label_k8s_incident_agent_io_readiness_container!="",label_k8s_incident_agent_io_readiness_slo="2m"}, "container", "$1", "label_k8s_incident_agent_io_readiness_container", "(.+)") unless on (namespace, pod, container) label_replace(kube_pod_labels{label_k8s_incident_agent_io_liveness_container!=""}, "container", "$1", "label_k8s_incident_agent_io_liveness_container", "(.+)")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) > 0

panels.title: 探针持续失败的容器数
panels.purpose: 每个采样区间（至少 5 分钟）内探针失败不少于 3 次、且已启动超过 5 分钟的容器数；受控 readiness / liveness 容器由各自规则负责，不在此计入。
panels.queryTemplate: sum(((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(prober_probe_total{namespace="{{namespace}}",job="kubelet-probes",result="failed"}[{{range:5m}}])) >= bool 3) and on (namespace, pod, container) ((time() - max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_state_started{namespace="{{namespace}}"})) > 300) unless on (namespace, pod, container) label_replace(kube_pod_labels{namespace="{{namespace}}",label_k8s_incident_agent_io_readiness_container!=""}, "container", "$1", "label_k8s_incident_agent_io_readiness_container", "(.+)") unless on (namespace, pod, container) label_replace(kube_pod_labels{namespace="{{namespace}}",label_k8s_incident_agent_io_liveness_container!=""}, "container", "$1", "label_k8s_incident_agent_io_liveness_container", "(.+)")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"))

rule.expression: max by (namespace, deployment) (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_unschedulable == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) > 0

panels.title: 无法调度的 Pod 数
panels.purpose: 尚未被调度的 Pod 数量，通常是调度器判定无法调度，也包括 scheduling gate 等待；它不是节点容量审计。
panels.queryTemplate: sum((max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_unschedulable{namespace="{{namespace}}"} == 1)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)")) or (max(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}) * 0)

alerts.triggerSummary: An explicitly monitored PersistentVolumeClaim has remained Pending beyond its immediate-binding policy.

panels.title: PVC Pending 状态
panels.purpose: PVC 是否 Pending（1 = 是），不说明存储后端原因。
panels.queryTemplate: max(kube_persistentvolumeclaim_status_phase{namespace="{{namespace}}",persistentvolumeclaim="{{name}}",phase="Pending"})

panels.title: PVC Pending 时长
panels.purpose: PVC 持续 Pending 的秒数，仅 Pending 时有值。
panels.queryTemplate: max((time() - kube_persistentvolumeclaim_created{namespace="{{namespace}}",persistentvolumeclaim="{{name}}"}) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_status_phase{namespace="{{namespace}}",persistentvolumeclaim="{{name}}",phase="Pending"} == bool 1))

panels.title: 容器 CPU 用量与限额
panels.purpose: 每个容器在每个采样区间（至少 2 分钟）的平均 CPU 核数，usage 是用量、limit 是上限。没有 limit 线表示该容器未配置上限。最多展示 4 个容器，更多时标为部分数据。
panels.queryTemplate: sum by (pod, uid, container, series) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="{{namespace}}",job="kubelet-resource"}[{{range:2m}}]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(uid, replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"), "series", "usage", "", "") or label_replace(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="{{namespace}}",resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left(uid, replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"), "series", "limit", "", ""))

panels.title: 容器内存工作集与限额
panels.purpose: 每个容器的内存工作集，usage 是用量、limit 是上限。贴近上限说明压力大，但不等于已经发生 OOM。没有 limit 线表示该容器未配置上限。最多展示 4 个容器，更多时标为部分数据。
panels.queryTemplate: sum by (pod, uid, container, series) (label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="{{namespace}}",job="kubelet-resource"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left(uid, replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"), "series", "usage", "", "") or label_replace(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="{{namespace}}",resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left(uid, replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"), "series", "limit", "", ""))

panels.title: 容器 CPU 限流周期比例
panels.purpose: 每个容器在每个采样区间（至少 2 分钟）内，被 CFS 限流的调度周期占全部周期的比例，不是耗时比例。没有数据表示该容器未配置 CPU 上限，不能当作 0。
panels.queryTemplate: sum by (pod, uid, container, series) (label_replace((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="{{namespace}}",job="kubelet-cadvisor"}[{{range:2m}}])) / (sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="{{namespace}}",job="kubelet-cadvisor"}[{{range:2m}}])) > 0)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(uid, replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"), "series", "throttled_ratio", "", ""))

panels.title: 容器探针失败次数
panels.purpose: 每个容器在每个采样区间（至少 5 分钟）内探针失败的次数，按探针类型分开。容器刚启动时的失败往往是正常现象。
panels.queryTemplate: sum by (pod, uid, container, series) (label_replace(sum by (namespace, pod, container, probe_type) (increase(prober_probe_total{namespace="{{namespace}}",job="kubelet-probes",result!="successful"}[{{range:5m}}])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(uid, replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"), "series", "$1", "probe_type", "(.+)"))

panels.title: 容器最近一次终止原因
panels.purpose: 每条色条表示在该时段内，这个容器最近一次终止的原因就是色条标注的那一项。色条起点是这次终止被记录的时刻，终点表示被更近一次终止取代；没有色条表示当时不是该原因，也可能这个容器从未终止过。
panels.queryTemplate: sum by (pod, uid, container, series) (label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="{{namespace}}"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(uid, replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"), "series", "$1", "reason", "(.+)"))

panels.title: 未调度 Pod
panels.purpose: 只有尚未被调度的 Pod 才会出现在这里；出现即表示该时刻这个 Pod 仍未被调度，通常是调度器判定无法调度，也包括 scheduling gate 等待。它不是节点容量审计。
panels.queryTemplate: max by (pod, uid) (kube_pod_status_unschedulable{namespace="{{namespace}}"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left(uid, replicaset) label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)") * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left(deployment) label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="{{namespace}}",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="{{name}}"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"))
